name: skillstate
description: External validated task state for long-horizon coding work: the agent patches a compact state instead of relying on the transcript, so progress survives compaction and restarts (arXiv:2608.26263).

settings.name: skillstate home
settings.description: Absolute path to the skillstate repository that contains dist/mcp/server.js. Needed when this extension is installed outside that repository.

settings.name: state directory
settings.description: Absolute path of the .skillstate directory to use. Set it when you start qwen outside the project: the server and the hooks otherwise take qwen's startup directory.

settings.name: supervised projects
settings.description: Additional .skillstate roots the tools may address by name, as "name=dir;name2=dir2" or a JSON object of the same. Only roots declared here are reachable through the project argument, so a session can read and patch the task of a worker in another project without ever reaching an arbitrary directory. The hooks inject the active task of each declared root.

hooks.name: skillstate-precompact-state
hooks.statusMessage: Adding skillstate task state to the compaction context
